oakland.Notes: A's host Twins in game 1 and 2 in Oakland and win both games behind a game 1 win by Travis Coles and game 2 win by Arturo Ramos. Enter game in 3 in Minnesota. The A's bats explode in game 3 and the A's bullpen appears as its potential achilies heal. The A's would get on the great start with a 5-2 lead through 5 innings behind 4 hrs. However 6th inning the Twins would finally get to Rivas for 3 runs and continue the inning on to get 3 more off Hitoki Ka. Through 7 innings the A's would be trailing 6-5. In the 8th the A's would hit back to back homeruns with Gonzalez and Desmond Morton. The A's would tack on 2 more homeruns in the 9th to win 9-6. Mike Paulson spoke on how special the season has been and chasing a 7th championship in the dynasty window. Paulson sharing that its extra special to be doing it on Vinnie Keanes farewell season. Adding that the idea of the A's without Keane and Dillon next season is a sobering thought and trying to savor it all. Paulson also gave praise to first year manager Deacon Seymour on making the World Series and joked, "you set the bar too high kid". Deacon Seymour also addressed the media and confirmed that the A's would start Arturo Ramos in game 1. Ramos who was the Ace this season and runner up in the Cy Young race to teammate Travis Coles, saw Coles starting game 1 of the previous 2 series. When Seymour was asked why on the change, Seymour stated the matchups and favor Ramos a bit more. Seymour was also asked to speak on MVP Danny Horn's struggles this season and if there were any plans to move Horn from the leadoff spot.Horn is batting just .190 with 0 homeruns. Seymour acknowledged Horn may be pressing a bit and has no doubt Horn bat will influence the next series and wouldnt think to move him from his natural leadoff spot.
